title: Core ablation
machine: edge-os-arm64-vm (comparative proxy; physical Pi 5 pending D8/D10)
hardware_disclosure: physical Pi 5 not connected: VM service-time pools (comparative proxy) x Pi multiplier s; simulated delivery on replayed detections

E3-D1.detail: F(W > L) at zero delay vs E02 burst{W} (all / dev / confirmation), tolerance 0.02 pt

E3-D2.detail: continuous run tables (tracker re-created every Delta frames) vs E02 K=1 persistent tracker, zero delay; pass if |all| <= 0.5 pt

E3-D3.detail: rows of frames the policy did not request are set to NaN: decisions, costs and delivered values unchanged; feedback is popped only for jobs with finish <= job start (simulate())

E3-D4.detail: E02 queue invariants on a full stream of every headline family at (2.0, 0.50)

E3-D5.detail: zero-service landing == ideal series; simulating only the first half of the clips leaves every earlier clip's delivered series unchanged

E3-D6.detail: realised cost / target in [0.97, 1.005] after calibration, or the cell is flagged under / over-spending

E3-D7.detail: C1 never reuses a detector output older than A1, C2 never a score older than A2 (state is reset at every clip / run start; the elevated-anomaly source test is the nu_safe condition, unit-tested)
